title: Protected-metric threshold-change ledger with before/after evidence, rationale, approval lineage, and waiver expiry
summary: Binds the threshold history of every protected benchmark metric to a typed, reviewable change record: the change kind and resulting threshold state, whether it loosens the protected bar, its structured rationale and comparability note, its before/after evidence packet, its owner, its approval lineage, its waiver grant and expiry, and its release-evidence linkage. An easing requires both the performance-owner and architecture-board approvals plus structured before/after evidence and release-evidence linkage; a non-default waiver requires its granting authority's approval and an expiry; and an open, in-force waiver past its expiry blocks promotion.
